mission_07: Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) is a wrapper method that recursively removes the least important features based on a model's feature importance or coefficients. Unlike univariate methods, RFE considers feature interactions by evaluating subsets of features. It starts with all features, fits a model, removes the least important feature, and repeats until the desired number of features remains. In this mission, you will use RFE with LogisticRegression to select the top 5 features from a 10-feature dataset, learning how RFE ranks features and why it often outperforms simpler selection methods.
